correctness.rationale: Reconstructing the exploded-star reduced Świątkowski complex gives a regular sequence of edge differences. Weight-two first homology is the second exterior module, and the vertex-explosion kernel in weight three is exactly the image of the injective third Koszul differential, yielding \(\bigwedge^3 A_m\). Naturality identifies four-edge theta classes with the displayed wedges; exterior expansion gives the five-term relations and reduction to a fixed-edge basis proves completeness. Fresh exact integer matrices for \(4\le m\le8\) reproduce the expected ranks and exact boundary-to-theta zero composition; these finite checks only corroborate the unbounded Koszul proof.

final_claim: For every integer \(m\ge4\), \(H_2(B_3(\Theta_m);\mathbb Z)\) is \(S_m\)-equivariantly \(\bigwedge^3 A_m\); each oriented four-edge theta class maps to the corresponding exterior wedge, fixed-edge theta classes form an integral basis, and all integral theta-class relations are generated by five-edge boundary relations.
limitations: Restricted to unordered three-point configurations of generalized theta graphs in degree two; no higher-particle or cohomology-product claim.
